test_cases.description: load_spec_landscape calls discover_specs for active specs and scans archive/ for archived specs matching _SPEC_DIR_RE, returning one entry per discovered spec.
preconditions: spec_root directory exists with two active spec directories (e.g., 01_core_foundation, 02_backend_protocol)
spec_root/archive/ directory exists with one archived spec directory (e.g., 08_old_spec)
Each spec directory contains a valid prd.md with YAML frontmatter
test_cases.expected: Returns a list of 3 dicts: 2 active entries and 1 archived entry, each with at minimum spec_id and spec_name fields
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
result = load_spec_landscape(spec_root, include_archive=True)
assert len(result) == 3
assert any(e['spec_id'] == '01' and e['archived'] == False for e in result)
assert any(e['spec_id'] == '02' and e['archived'] == False for e in result)
assert any(e['spec_id'] == '08' and e['archived'] == True for e in result)

test_cases.description: Each active spec entry returned by load_spec_landscape contains all six required keys with non-null string values.
preconditions: spec_root contains one active spec directory 01_core_foundation
prd.md has YAML frontmatter with spec_id, spec_name, status, title fields
prd.md body contains a ## Intent section with text content
test_cases.expected: The single returned entry contains keys spec_id, spec_name, title, status, intent, archived with archived=False and all string values non-null
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
result = load_spec_landscape(spec_root, include_archive=False)
assert len(result) == 1
entry = result[0]
for key in ['spec_id', 'spec_name', 'title', 'status', 'intent']:
    assert key in entry
    assert isinstance(entry[key], str)
assert entry['archived'] == False

test_cases.description: Each archived spec entry contains exactly spec_id, spec_name, title, status, and archived=True, with no intent key.
preconditions: spec_root/archive/ contains one archived spec directory 08_old_spec
08_old_spec/prd.md has valid YAML frontmatter with spec_id, spec_name, status, title
test_cases.expected: The archived entry contains spec_id, spec_name, title, status, archived=True and does NOT contain an 'intent' key
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
result = load_spec_landscape(spec_root, include_archive=True)
archived_entries = [e for e in result if e['archived'] == True]
assert len(archived_entries) == 1
entry = archived_entries[0]
for key in ['spec_id', 'spec_name', 'title', 'status']:
    assert key in entry
assert entry['archived'] == True
assert 'intent' not in entry

test_cases.description: load_spec_landscape excludes the spec whose spec_id matches current_spec_id from the returned list.
preconditions: spec_root contains active spec directories 01_core_foundation and 02_backend_protocol
Both directories have valid prd.md files
test_cases.expected: Returns a list with only the entry for spec 02; no entry with spec_id '01' is present
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
result = load_spec_landscape(spec_root, include_archive=False, current_spec_id='01')
assert all(e['spec_id'] != '01' for e in result)
assert any(e['spec_id'] == '02' for e in result)

test_cases.description: load_spec_landscape returns an empty list without re-raising when any exception is raised during discovery or file I/O.
preconditions: discover_specs is mocked/patched to raise an OSError
test_cases.expected: Returns [] without raising any exception
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
with mock discover_specs raising OSError:

test_cases.description: When called with include_archive=False, load_spec_landscape skips the archive directory and returns only active spec entries.
preconditions: spec_root contains one active spec directory 01_core_foundation
spec_root/archive/ contains one archived spec directory 08_old_spec
Both directories have valid prd.md files
test_cases.expected: Returns a list containing only active entries; no entry with archived=True

assert all(e['archived'] == False for e in result)

test_cases.description: Intent extraction reads the ## Intent section from prd.md body and returns its text truncated to 300 characters.
preconditions:
prd.md exists with YAML frontmatter and a body containing '## Intent
This spec establishes the core foundation...
## Background
...' where the intent text is 350 characters long
test_cases.expected: Returned intent string is at most 300 characters long and contains content from the ## Intent section, not from ## Background
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
result = load_spec_landscape(spec_root, include_archive=False)
entry = result[0]
assert len(entry['intent']) <= 300
assert 'core foundation' in entry['intent'].lower()
assert 'Background' not in entry['intent']

test_cases.description: When no ## Intent section exists in prd.md, the intent falls back to the first non-empty paragraph of the body, truncated to 300 characters.
preconditions: prd.md exists with YAML frontmatter
prd.md body has no ## Intent section
prd.md body first non-empty paragraph is 'This is the fallback paragraph describing the spec purpose.'
test_cases.expected: Returned intent field contains the first paragraph text, length <= 300
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
result = load_spec_landscape(spec_root, include_archive=False)
entry = result[0]
assert 'fallback paragraph' in entry['intent']
assert len(entry['intent']) <= 300

test_cases.description: When a landscape section is present with an overlapping active spec, the assessment LLM returns an Assessment containing at least one gap and one clarification question referencing the overlapping spec.

assessment_system.md includes the ## Cross-spec awareness section
LLM client is connected (or a recorded fixture is available)

input.prd_text:
# New PRD
## Intent
Provide core foundation utilities for the project.
...

spec_landscape.intent: Establish core foundation utilities for the project
spec_landscape.title: Core Foundation

test_cases.expected: Returned Assessment contains gaps list with at least one gap referencing spec '01' and clarification_questions list with at least one question about the overlap

assert len(assessment.clarification_questions) >= 1

test_cases.description: When a PRD overlaps with an archived spec, the assessment notes the historical precedent but does not block ready quality solely on that basis.

# The archived overlap should be noted but not mandatory-block ready

assert assessment is not None
# Check that a note about the archived spec appears somewhere in the assessment output
output_str = str(assessment)
assert '09' in output_str or 'worktree' in output_str.lower()

test_cases.description: When a PRD references capabilities already provided by an existing active spec, the assessment returns a dependency suggestion for that spec.

property_tests.description: For any call to load_spec_landscape that raises any exception internally, the function returns [] and does not propagate the exception.

property_tests.invariant_check: result = load_spec_landscape(spec_root); assert result == []; # verify no exception propagated by reaching this line

property_tests.description: For any call to _format_spec_landscape with None or [], the function returns exactly the empty string.

property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate prd.md files with ## Intent sections of varying lengths (0 to 1000 characters); run load_spec_landscape and inspect each entry with archived=False
property_tests.invariant_check: for every entry in result where entry['archived'] == False: assert len(entry['intent']) <= 300

property_tests.description: For any archived spec entry produced by load_spec_landscape, the entry dict does not contain the key 'intent'.

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test: running spec assess for a new PRD injects the landscape into the LLM prompt and returns an Assessment with landscape-aware content.
smoke_tests.trigger: User runs `spec assess` CLI command against a spec directory containing prd.md, with sibling specs present in the parent directory
mockable: LLM client (SpecAgent internal HTTP call) — return a canned Assessment JSON with a gap referencing a sibling spec
expected_effects: load_spec_landscape is called with the parent of the current spec directory and the current spec_id
The prompt sent to the LLM contains a '## Existing Spec Landscape' section listing sibling specs
The returned Assessment object is persisted to disk
No exception is raised during the entire flow

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test: running spec refine injects the landscape into the refinement prompt and returns an updated Assessment and revised PRD text.
smoke_tests.trigger: User runs `spec refine` with answers dict against a spec directory, with sibling specs present
mockable: LLM client (SpecAgent internal HTTP call) — return a canned (updated_prd_text, Assessment) response
expected_effects: The refinement prompt contains '## Existing Spec Landscape'
prd.md is overwritten with updated PRD text
A (str, Assessment) tuple is returned to the caller

smoke_tests.description: Graceful degradation smoke test: when landscape loading fails during spec assess, assessment proceeds without landscape context and returns a valid Assessment.
smoke_tests.trigger: User runs `spec assess` while the spec parent directory is temporarily unreadable (permission denied)
mockable: LLM client (SpecAgent internal HTTP call) — return a valid Assessment with no landscape-related content
expected_effects: SpecSession.assess catches the OSError from load_spec_landscape
The prompt sent to LLM does NOT contain '## Existing Spec Landscape'
A valid Assessment is returned to the CLI
No error about the failed landscape load is surfaced to the user
